task: Get a brief overview of the economic implications of the UK's latest trade deal posted on BBC News and the date when the article was published.
answer: The UK's latest trade deal covered on BBC News is the India-UK Free Trade Agreement, in the article 'From Wimbledon towels to Scotch: What India-UK trade deal could mean for shoppers' (https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0kymrz0vkgo), published on 14 July 2026. Economic implications: the deal removes/reduces tariffs on 99% of Indian exports to the UK and 90% of UK imports into India; it is the UK's biggest bilateral trade pact since Brexit; long-term estimates put the gain at 0.13% (about £4.8bn) of UK GDP and 0.06% (about £5.1bn) of India's GDP per year; it boosts labour-intensive sectors such as textiles, garments, footwear, cars and marine products; Scotch whisky duty in India will fall from 150% to 75% and then to 40% over 10 years; overall the impact is expected to be incremental rather than transformational.
